source.statement:
SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(o.ORDER_DATE_KEY::VARCHAR, 'YYYYMMDD'))   AS SALE_MONTH,
        c.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT,
        p.CATEGORY,
        s.REGION,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID)                    AS ORDER_COUNT,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.CUSTOMER_KEY)                AS CUSTOMER_COUNT,
        SUM(o.GROSS_REVENUE)                          AS TOTAL_GROSS_REVENUE,
        SUM(o.NET_REVENUE)                            AS TOTAL_NET_REVENUE,
        SUM(o.GROSS_PROFIT)                           AS TOTAL_GROSS_PROFIT,
        SUM(o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT)                        AS TOTAL_DISCOUNTS,
        AVG(o.NET_REVENUE)                            AS AVG_ORDER_VALUE,
        SUM(o.QUANTITY_ORDERED)                       AS TOTAL_UNITS
      FROM CSA.TJ.ORDER_FACT o
      LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.CUSTOMER_DIM c ON o.CUSTOMER_KEY = c.CUSTOMER_KEY
      LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.PRODUCT_DIM p  ON o.PRODUCT_KEY  = p.PRODUCT_KEY
      LEFT JOIN CSA.TJ.STORE_DIM s    ON o.ORDER_STORE_KEY = s.STORE_KEY
      WHERE o.IS_CANCELLED = 0
        AND o.NET_REVENUE > 0
      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
